title: Check if Array is Sorted
description: Determine if an array is sorted in non-decreasing order.

data.text: Given an array `arr`, check if it is sorted in non-decreasing order.
Compare every pair of elements. O(n²) time.

data.title: Brute Force O(n²)
data.content: Compare every pair of elements to verify the array is sorted.

data.text: Check adjacent pairs. If any pair is out of order, the array is not sorted. O(n) time.

data.title: Linear Scan O(n)
data.content: Check adjacent pairs to verify the array is sorted.

data.title: What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n²) → O(n). **Space:** O(1) in both. The linear scan checks only adjacent pairs and short-circuits on the first violation.
